verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official MCP server that gives AI assistants and agents access to the Admin API. The Admin API covers everything the dashboard can do, so a user could manage flags, segments and environments in natural language through an external AI assistant. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the product itself, and no hands-on reports of this working. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of example natural-language workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP-driven operation.
